description: Free read-only service returning dog breed lists and random dog photos as JSON, no key needed.

operations.name: list_all_breeds
operations.summary: List every dog breed and its sub-breeds.
operations.when_to_call: Call when you need the valid breed names, for example before asking for a picture of one breed.
operations.response_description: Object with message (breed name to list of sub-breed names) and status.
operations.evidence_quote: Send a GET request to `/breeds/list/all`. It takes no parameters.

operations.name: get_random_dog_image
operations.summary: Get the web address of one random dog photo from any breed.
operations.when_to_call: Call when you want a random dog picture and do not care about the breed.
operations.response_description: Object with message (photo URL) and status.
operations.evidence_quote: Send a GET request to `/breeds/image/random`. It takes no parameters.

operations.name: get_random_image_by_breed
operations.summary: Get the web address of one random photo of a chosen breed.
operations.when_to_call: Call when you want a random picture of a specific main breed such as hound.

params.name: breed
params.description: Main breed name, for example hound.

operations.response_description: Object with message (photo URL) and status.
operations.evidence_quote: The `breed` value is required and is part of the path.
